sections: Start with the two sides

Left: change sensor inputs and starting switches. Right: choose a section in the ribbon. That section shows its process display and matching graphs. All values come from one shared model; changing tabs does not start another engine or change the calculations.
Your first run

Load a preset, Run simulation, switch ignition and simulated authorisation on, then press Start engine. Defaults impose 800 rpm; after priming and cranking the sequence can reach RUN. RPM is a student input: the model does not calculate mechanical acceleration.
What does Step mean?

This module uses a fixed calculation interval of 0.05 seconds: 20 samples per simulated second. Step advances exactly one sample while paused. It does not mean a sudden coolant-temperature change. Time in state means how long the current OFF, PRIME, CRANK, RUN or SHUTDOWN state has lasted. Inputs are queued and applied at the next sample.
Fuel and injection

Use the Fuel and injection ribbon tab. Injector pulse width means how long the injector is commanded open for each event, in milliseconds. Positive STFT adds fuel; negative STFT removes fuel when closed loop is active. Try O2 voltage 0.10 V after RUN and compare with the warm default 0.45 V. The illustration is a command diagram, not a measured spray or fuel-consumption model.
Idle and ignition

Compare target RPM with imposed actual RPM. Error is target minus actual RPM while idle control is active. Accessory load can increase the duty command. A larger duty does not automatically accelerate the imposed RPM input. Ignition timing is degrees before top dead centre; negative timing means after it.
Cooling

Virtual ECT sensor voltages become two temperatures. The hotter value controls cooling. Fan and virtual electric-pump percentages are commands, not measured speeds or flow. A difference above 15 °C flags disagreement. The separate physical 1NZ rig has no electric water pump.
Start and run

OFF waits for a permitted start request. PRIME lasts 2 s. CRANK permits the starter and times out at 5 s if imposed RPM does not reach the running threshold. SHUTDOWN lasts 0.5 s. Start requires ignition, simulated authorisation, at least 9.5 V and no emergency. Emergency stop is latched until deliberately cleared. These are virtual switch inputs, not voice or biometric recognition.
Read the graphs and legends

Each panel uses its own labelled unit and vertical scale. Solid, dashed and dotted lines distinguish signals as well as colour. Hover or focus a legend label for its meaning. Move the sample slider to inspect history; live simulation continues unless paused. History retains the latest 60 s, up to 1201 samples. CSV exports retained sampled history rather than a hardware log.
Verify one change at a time

Pause to inspect the current result. Load a preset for a fresh experiment; a latched emergency remains set. Reset restores all defaults and clears history. Try low battery to see start inhibition; change O2 voltage to see fuel correction; change one ECT voltage to inspect disagreement. Compare expected versus observed behaviour and keep your input configuration with exports.
Advanced scope and evidence

The pure reference controller preserves input caps, equations, state transitions and fixed 0.05 s sampling. Numerical and browser tests verify the educational software; they do not prove OEM calibration, engine combustion, hardware response or real-vehicle safety. Process animation is qualitative and stops with pause or reduced motion. The calculations are unchanged in this interface revision.

meanings.BatteryVoltage: Used for safe-start permission and injector battery compensation.
meanings.EngineSpeed: Student-selected RPM; affects starting, injection, idle and ignition.
meanings.ThrottlePosition: TPS: throttle position; affects load, injection and idle activation.
meanings.ManifoldPressure: MAP: manifold absolute pressure; affects load, injection and timing.
meanings.O2SensorVoltage: Simplified oxygen feedback used to estimate lambda and fuel correction.
meanings.ECT1Voltage: Virtual ECT1 input; affects fuel, idle and cooling calculations.
meanings.ECT2Voltage: Virtual ECT2 input; used for cooling demand and sensor plausibility.
meanings.AccessoryLoad: Represents the added idle-control demand of electrical accessories.
meanings.IgnitionSwitch: Simulated ignition status; turning it off requests shutdown.
meanings.StartAuthorisation: Simulated permission; no biometric recognition is performed.
meanings.ACRequest: Requests at least 35% fan duty when state code is CRANK or higher.
meanings.StartRequest: A ten-sample virtual request; it cannot bypass safe-start checks.
meanings.StopRequest: A 0.5-second virtual request for normal shutdown.
meanings.EmergencyStop: Latched emergency request overrides engine and cooling commands.
meanings.ECT1Temp: Educational temperature calculated from virtual ECT1 voltage.
meanings.ECT2Temp: Educational temperature calculated from virtual ECT2 voltage.
meanings.SensorDifference: Absolute difference between the two calculated temperatures.
meanings.ControlTemperature: The hotter calculated coolant temperature controls cooling.
meanings.EngineLoad: Weighted load estimate from MAP and TPS.
meanings.LambdaEstimate: Simplified air/fuel indication: above 1 is lean, below 1 is rich.
meanings.STFT: Positive correction adds fuel; negative correction removes fuel when closed loop is active.
meanings.BatteryCompensation: Injector delay compensation at lower battery voltage.
meanings.BaseInjectorPW: Uncorrected injection duration derived from RPM, MAP and TPS.
meanings.TargetIdleRPM: Coolant-dependent idle target, from 750 to 1200 rpm.
meanings.RPMError: Target minus actual RPM while idle control is active.
meanings.InjectorPW: Corrected injection duration; zero when injection is disabled.
meanings.IdleControlDuty: Idle actuator duty based on speed error and accessory load.
meanings.IgnitionTiming: Commanded degrees BTDC; a negative value represents ATDC.
meanings.WaterPumpDuty: Virtual electric pump command; no electric pump exists in the physical 1NZ setup.
meanings.FuelPumpState: Fuel-pump relay is on during PRIME, CRANK and RUN.
meanings.StarterState: Starter relay is on only during CRANK.
meanings.InjectionEnable: Injection is allowed only during CRANK and RUN.
meanings.IgnitionEnable: Ignition is allowed only during CRANK and RUN.
meanings.StartPermitted: Indicates an active PRIME, CRANK or RUN sequence.
meanings.ClosedLoopActive: Requires enabled injection, ECT1 at least 70 °C and RPM at least 600.
meanings.IdleActive: Requires RUN, TPS at most 5% and RPM below 2000.
meanings.CoolingLoopActive: At least one virtual cooling actuator has nonzero duty.
meanings.SensorDisagreement: Set when virtual ECT temperatures differ by more than 15 °C.
meanings.EngineState: OFF, PRIME, CRANK, RUN or SHUTDOWN.
meanings.StateElapsedTime: Virtual seconds since the current engine state was entered.
meanings.SafeStartCondition: Includes the momentary start request; it normally returns false after the pulse, even during RUN.
meanings.ActualRPM: Imposed engine speed input; commands do not automatically change it.
